The '''Corthenia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Traval-Pacor system/Legends|Traval-Pacor]] and [[Vvan system|Tyan systems]].<ref name="Warfare" />

The Corthenia system was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Corthenian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Cestus" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> The system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when an [[Battle of Corthenia|attack]] by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] resulted in a victory for the latter faction.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corthenia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square K-7.<ref name="TEA" />
